
## Summary

**Rationalize charts and empty-state panels** (residual after DUX5)

Many empty charts occupy full panel height and say No data.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P2**
- Wave: **V3**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P2-03`
- DUX code: `DUX6-22`

## Scope

DQ, Provider, Pipeline, Trust, Overview.

Screenshot groups: SG-03..07 empty charts

## Concrete change

Keep charts only when a time relationship is decision-relevant; otherwise use compact evidence card. Collapse optional/global charts by default.

## Expected effect

Less visual dead space and clearer absence semantics.

## Acceptance criteria

- First viewport contains only actionable charts; optional empty charts are below fold/collapsed.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Dashboard layout changes.

## Risk

Removing a chart could reduce exploratory value; preserve drill-down.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7130 DUX5-22 closed — residual: empty-chart No data patterns inconsistent

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

DUX6 epic (#7139)
